lab-sections.title: Accessible Combo Box
lab-sections.challenge: A Combobox is one of the most complex components to make fully accessible. It requires a delicate balance of managing 'live' focus - where the user's cursor stays in an input field while their keyboard focus navigates a dynamic list - all while ensuring screen readers announce real-time filtering results and selection states without losing context.
lab-sections.solution: This implementation utilises Angular Signals for fine-grained reactivity and RxJS to handle asynchronous mock-API country data. By leveraging the aria-activedescendant pattern, the component maintains a seamless keyboard experience, while a dedicated aria-live region provides immediate auditory feedback on search results. The result is a high-performance, WCAG-compliant search interface that handles large datasets with professional-grade focus and scroll management.

lab-sections.title: Accessible Tabs (Headless)
lab-sections.challenge: Tabs are a staple of modern UI, yet they represent a significant accessibility challenge that goes far beyond simple visibility toggles. A robust implementation must synchronise complex keyboard interactions (such as arrow-key navigation) with hidden ARIA relationships to ensure the interface remains intuitive for users relying on assistive technologies.
lab-sections.solution: This implementation uses Angular Aria to provide a 'headless' logic layer. It ensures full WCAG compliance, including automatic focus management and correct ARIA roles, while allowing for completely custom styling via SCSS.

lab-sections.title: Accessible Modal (Headless)
lab-sections.challenge: Modals are a common UI pattern, but they present unique accessibility challenges. They require a delicate balance of focus trapping, background silencing, and intuitive dismissal flows. When a dialog opens, screen reader users must not be able to navigate to the background content, focus must land immediately inside the modal, and pressing Escape must close it safely while returning focus to the exact element that triggered it.
lab-sections.solution: This implementation uses the Angular CDK Dialog module for its robust, headless overlay foundation. By utilising the cdkFocusInitial directive, the component places the focus to the primary input field upon opening. Clean semantic markup, explicit button labeling and custom SCSS styling combine to provide a fully WCAG-compliant experience.
